items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: During the year 1927 I also played with Harry Southern's band

ctx.x: We'll touch on Mr. Sturdivant later in our interview.

During the year 1927 I also played with Harry Southern's band, out at Belman's Open Air out in Widiam (phonetic spelling). I also played with Herb Williams who had a job up in San Francisco on the beach in San Francisco. Now I'm going into June, 1928.
Let me ask you just a couple more questions about 1927.
